enhance.title: AI Image Enhance
enhance.desc: Enhance image clarity and resolution using AI
enhance.syncAllTooltip: Sync current settings to all files
enhance.emptyDesc: PNG / JPG / WEBP; short video MVP (≤45s, long edge ≤1280, 2× only)
enhance.toastApiKey: Please configure API Key in settings for {provider}
enhance.modelDescCugan: Best for anime, sharp lines, no painting effect
enhance.modelDescGfpgan: Photo / portrait priority via Real-ESRGAN x4plus (no separate GFPGAN binary in this build)
enhance.hardwareWarning: Dedicated GPU recommended. Video enhance is a local frame MVP (≤45s / 2×); time scales with frame count. Cancel anytime.
enhance.noResultsToCompress: No enhanced images to send (videos stay in the output folder)
enhance.cloudRetired: Cloud enhance is no longer available. Pick a local model.
enhance.videoScaleCapped: Video enhance is limited to 2× in this version
enhance.videoPreviewUnavailable: Quick preview is for images. Start enhance for short videos (≤45s).
enhance.videoSmartSkip: Video: CUGAN for anime, Real-ESRGAN for live action
enhance.videoReadyHint: Video loaded. Max 45s / 2× — press Start enhance.
enhance.videoDoneHint: Video ready — use Open output folder
enhance.videoPreviewFail: Could not preview video. You can still Start enhance.
enhance.videoTooLongImport: Skipped {count} video(s) over {max}s (e.g. {duration}s). Trim first or use a short clip.
enhance.videoProbeFailImport: Skipped {count} video(s): could not read duration
enhance.videoTooLong: Video longer than {max}s is not supported. Trim first or use a short clip.

errors.apiKeyMissing: API key for {provider} is not configured. Add it in Settings.
errors.falNoUrl: Fal.ai did not return a valid image URL
errors.openaiNoUpscale: OpenAI does not support Real-ESRGAN-style upscaling here. Use Replicate.
errors.unzipFailed: Extract failed. Try unpacking the package manually.
errors.noEngineConfig: No download config found for this engine
errors.tooManyFrames: Too many frames for this version. Use a shorter clip or lower frame rate.
errors.engineNotReady: Engine not installed. Download it from the model list first.
errors.gpuMemory: GPU memory or driver issue. Try Eco mode, close other apps, or use a smaller image.
errors.ffmpegMissing: ffmpeg is missing or failed. Check Settings → Core engines.

enhance.limitsBody: Short clips only: ≤45s · max long edge 1280 · scale 2× only · local GPU recommended.
